LanguageData.FH_LostSpike_Paraspike.label: lost spike
LanguageData.FH_LostSpike_Paraspike.description: The paraspike has lost the core spike it needs to sustain itself. If it cannot recover, it will wither and die.
LanguageData.FH_Parasitism_Fingerspike.label: fingerspike parasitism
LanguageData.FH_Parasitism_Fingerspike.description: This creature is parasitized by a fingerspike. The fleshbeast grants it additional abilities, but also imposes significant costs.\n\n-Bone-spike tentacle
LanguageData.FH_Parasitism_Gutspike.label: gutspike parasitism
LanguageData.FH_Parasitism_Gutspike.description: This creature is parasitized by a gutspike. The fleshbeast grants it additional abilities, but also imposes significant costs.\n\nThe host is almost immune to food poisoning, and gains immunity to gut worms while purging existing infestations.
LanguageData.FH_Parasitism_Paraspike.label: paraspike parasitism
LanguageData.FH_Parasitism_Paraspike.description:
This creature is parasitized by a paraspike. The fleshbeast grants it additional abilities, but also imposes significant costs.

Bleeding is reduced and wound infections are prevented. Offspring inherit this parasitism.

-Spiral tentacle
LanguageData.FH_Parasitism_Puffspike.label: puffspike parasitism
LanguageData.FH_Parasitism_Puffspike.description: This creature is parasitized by a puffspike. The fleshbeast grants it additional abilities, but also imposes significant costs.\n\nThe host is immune to asthma and lung rot, which are cured from its lungs. It moves faster and tolerates toxic environments better.
LanguageData.FH_Parasitism_Shatterspike.label: shatterspike parasitism
LanguageData.FH_Parasitism_Shatterspike.description: This creature is parasitized by a shatterspike. The fleshbeast grants it additional abilities, but also imposes significant costs.\n\n-Shatter-claw tentacle
LanguageData.FH_Parasitism_Shieldspike.label: shieldspike parasitism
LanguageData.FH_Parasitism_Shieldspike.description:
This creature is parasitized by a shieldspike. The fleshbeast grants it additional abilities, but also imposes significant costs.

The host gains stronger armor.

-Shield-claw tentacle
LanguageData.FH_Parasitism_Toughspike.label: toughspike parasitism
LanguageData.FH_Parasitism_Toughspike.description:
This creature is parasitized by a toughspike. The fleshbeast grants it additional abilities, but also imposes significant costs.

The host gains improved global work speed.

-Carapace tentacle
LanguageData.FH_Parasitism_Trispike.label: trispike parasitism
LanguageData.FH_Parasitism_Trispike.description:
This creature is parasitized by a trispike. The fleshbeast grants it additional abilities, but also imposes significant costs.

The host can release two random small fleshbeasts.

-Bone-spike tentacle
LanguageData.FH_Parasitism_Whipspike.label: whipspike parasitism
LanguageData.FH_Parasitism_Whipspike.description: This creature is parasitized by a whipspike. The fleshbeast grants it additional abilities, but also imposes significant costs.\n\n-Whip-claw tentacle
LanguageData.FH_Spike_Paraspike.label: paraspike's spike
LanguageData.FH_Spike_Paraspike.description: The paraspike's vital parasitic spike. It embeds in the host and continuously regulates flesh and blood.
